title: T4 — Closure review
body:
# T4 — Closure review

Project: T4 — Kanban coach · Track: v2 · Tranche: 4 · Plan: docs/SPEC_V2.md §12 · Measured at: main@f14b7d36, 2026-11-19 · Project row: closed

## Outcome vs acceptance

The acceptance set is the `docs/SPEC_V2.md` §12 row T4, which the project brief repeats verbatim: "an injected failure yields exactly one coach card and one remedy; a repeat signature escalates; no coach card about a coach card; a systemic class opens a kata".

| Gate clause | Evidence | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| An injected failure yields exactly one coach card and one remedy | `migrations/0057_coach.sql:uq_coach_interruption_open` and `:coach_remedy_one_per_interruption`; `crates/actions/src/coach.rs:coach_interrupt` creates one `coach` card and one coach run; `crates/actions/tests/coach.rs::an_interruption_yields_one_coach_card_one_triage_and_one_remedy`, `::the_coach_chain_settles_at_one_card` | pass |
| A repeat signature escalates | `crates/actions/src/coach.rs:coach_interrupt` closes an open same-signature interruption as `escalated` and opens one `ESCALATION_GATE` approval; `crates/actions/tests/coach.rs::a_repeat_signature_escalates_instead_of_a_second_card`, `::an_escalated_signature_is_not_retried` | pass |
| No coach card about a coach card | refusal `coach.about_a_coach` in `crates/actions/src/coach.rs:coach_interrupt` (and again at the enqueue boundary); `crates/actions/tests/coach.rs::a_failed_coach_run_never_opens_a_coach_card` | pass |
| A systemic class opens a kata | `crates/actions/src/coach.rs:coach_remedy` starts exactly one `kata.open` run for a class in the policy's systemic set and records `kata_candidate_id`; `crates/actions/tests/coach.rs::a_systemic_class_opens_one_kata`, `::a_transient_class_opens_no_kata` | pass |

All four clauses pass on merged evidence at `67ece618` (PR #379), with a green `ci` run (44433921046) at that sha. Two further design scenarios also have merged tests but are not §12 clauses: the closed sets refuse an out-of-set class or remedy (`::an_out_of_set_triage_or_remedy_is_refused`) and a below-floor triage routes to `ask` (`::a_low_confidence_triage_routes_to_ask`). The design's concurrency scenario has no test (Open item 2).

## Evidence

- Merge: PR #379 "T4: the kanban coach — one interruption, one card, one triage, one remedy (#75)", merged 2026-11-19T01:03:21Z at `67ece6189f93c642c9797875b06e643e6387584c`; issue #75 closed 2026-11-19T01:03Z.
- Schema: `migrations/0057_coach.sql` — `coach_interruption` (five-value class CHECK, four-value state CHECK, partial unique open-signature index, FORCE RLS) and `coach_remedy` (six-value CHECK, one row per interruption, FORCE RLS).
- Code: `crates/actions/src/coach.rs` — `coach_interrupt`, `coach_triage`, `coach_remedy`, `coach_escalate`, plus the policy defaults `COACH_POLICY_KIND`, `DEFAULT_WINDOW_HOURS`, `DEFAULT_CONFIDENCE_FLOOR`, `DEFAULT_SYSTEMIC_CLASS`; `crates/store/src/coach.rs` — `TRIAGE_CLASSES`, `REMEDY_CLASSES`, `COACH_CARD_TYPE`, the `_tx` readers and writers; `crates/actions/src/board/pull.rs:err_card` — the single capture path.
- Seed: `seed/processes/named.yaml` (`cap.kanban_coach.handle_error.v2`, `allowed_actions` include `coach.triage`, not `coach.remedy`); `seed/organisation.json` (`kanban_coach`).
- Tests: nine test functions in `crates/actions/tests/coach.rs` — the seven gate-relevant ones above plus the out-of-set and low-confidence tests.
- CI: `ci` run 44433921046 `success` at the merge sha; PR-head `ci` run 44431792434 `success`; CodeQL 44433920565 and board 44433920983 green.
- Slice descriptor: `scripts/v2-slice-artefacts.json` row T4 names `coach_interruption`, `coach_remedy` and the four `coach.*` actions, with `gap: null`.
- This review did not execute the tests or drive a live tenant; the pass claim rests on the merged test files and the CI record.

## Open items

1. **Class→remedy matrix.** T4-AM-01 fixes 5×6 cells as default/allowed/refused; `coach_remedy` enforces closed-set membership and the confidence floor only, with a class-derived default. No cell is refused in code. Owner: a T4 follow-up; no issue, branch or PR verified.
2. **Concurrency.** The design's `coach_concurrent_signature` scenario has no test; `uq_coach_interruption_open` is the enforcement and the race is unproven. Owner: T4 follow-up.
3. **Seed records disagree.** `seed/organisation.json` (`kanban_coach.definition.grants`) lists `coach.remedy`, while the v2 process `allowed_actions` exclude it. The process list is the runtime gate; the two records should be reconciled by the seed release owner.
4. **Design deviations.** Migration name (`0057_coach.sql` vs `0052_t4_coach.sql`), column (`state`/`closed_at` vs `status`), card type (`coach` vs `coach_interruption`) and placement (interrupted card's lane, no parent, vs `waiting`-lane child). Recorded as decision Q1 in the migration, not as a §12 failure.
5. **Flow/WIP exclusion.** D-T4-3 relies on coach cards being excluded from flow and WIP reads; this review did not verify such a read predicate.
6. **Kata boundary.** The handoff starts `kata.open`; the six Gets are T5 and are not delivered here.

## Decision

T4 is CLOSED, measured today. Issue #75 closed 2026-11-19T01:03Z and PR #379 merged at 2026-11-19T01:03:21Z (`67ece618`). All four `docs/SPEC_V2.md` §12 gate clauses pass on merged code, merged tests and a green `ci` run at the merge sha; the close is supported by its own gate, and this review records it rather than re-approving it. The gaps above are design-level details the gate never named — they are carried forward as open items, not treated as satisfied. The closure is honest in what it claims; it is not evidence that the coach's class→remedy policy or its concurrent behaviour is implemented beyond what the tests assert.
